summary: 104B mismatch path: comparison first loads byte48 from R5 then R4. Unequal route diagnostics independently load R4 then R5; mask path independently loads R4 to SP0 then R5 to R3 (mask 0x04800000), overwriting saved-slot alias. R6 is cleared after the mismatch diagnostic logic regardless of whether logging ran. Equal path skips this clear and continues beyond slice.
